notes: The illustrative label is one constant, policy.ILLUSTRATIVE_LABEL (no digits), for the pack tasks (T24-T26) to reuse. case_summary reads firm.yaml once per request; with show_policy_verdict on it loads the packaged policy only (never a firm file) and evaluates it per account through policy.evaluate on overrides.case_figures' metrics, so the panel follows overrides; a malformed packaged policy (PolicyError) is a refusal with no figures. With the setting off, the page shows only a note that the check is not shown, and the API data carries no outcome or rule result. The recommendation is a blank field (data-field=recommendation) in every rendered state, and recommendation: null in the API.
